mechanism_narrative: The level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as the market interprets a higher rate as a sign of economic strength and reduced risk of recession.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in the current environment are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 8.0%, it signals a weak labor market and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) both rise by more than 0.5% in the past month, it signals a strong housing market and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise by >0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: The joint condition of HOUST and RSAFS both rising by >0.5% fails to produce positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 225), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where CPIAUCSL > 225, a rise in FEDFUNDS does not lead to negative 20-day returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The level of industrial production (INDPRO) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as rising industrial output signals strong economic activity and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95, it signals an economic slowdown and reduced corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) falls below 650, it signals a weakening housing market and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 650, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The level of housing starts (HOUST) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as rising housing activity signals economic expansion and increased consumer confidence.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
